title: design
text:
design

Kira: quick design review — chart affordance around axis labels + units. proposal: only render the unit next to first and last tick (reduce clutter in small multiples). sketch: https://img.redwood/p/ux/2119987766.png
Ari: +1 on decluttering, but worried about discoverability. if users miss the unit it's a big problem. can we add a subtle top-left badge that always shows the unit for the whole small-multiple grid? :thinking:
Sam: @Ari implementation note: we can expose a `unitSuffixDisplay` flag (values: all | ends | hidden). cheap to implement; backed by renderer. also seeing smoothing issues — current MA window=5 erases short spikes that we actually want to surface for error budgets. recommend optional spike-overlay
Devon: CSS/ARIA nits: if only showing unit at ends, ensure `aria-label` on the chart container includes the unit (e.g. "Requests per minute (rpm)"). keyboard focus needs to announce units too. for the badge approach, make sure contrast meets 4.5:1.
Elena: UX suggestions: add toggle in chart toolbar: "Smoothing: On/Off" and a tooltip explainer: "Temporarily hides short spikes to reveal trend". copy tweak: change "Smooth noisy series" -> "Hide short-lived spikes" — clearer intent. also propose an outlier threshold slider (0-5 std dev) to control pinning.
Kira: good ideas. for legend treatment: propose hierarchical rows — metric name high-contrast, unit in muted line below (small caps). microcopy suggestion for settings: "Show units on axis" -> "Display measurement units on axis (for clarity)". also add a small 'i' tooltip next to unit toggle explaining why units sometimes omitted.
Sam: for outlier handling: would prefer overlay markers (red pins) instead of clipping. easier to correlate with events. we can emit `outlierPoints` as separate series so renderer doesn't lose perf.
Devon: will prototype aria announcements: when toggling smoothing announce "Smoothing enabled — spikes hidden". dev question — do we need separate labels for per-chart vs grid-level unit display?
Kira: yes, grid-level default = ends; per-chart user can override in chart settings. I'll update the spec and add copy variants.
VizBot: Screenshot uploaded: https://img.redwood/p/ux/2119987766-v1.png :white_check_mark:
Ari: thanks — will run a brief user sanity-check with support team tomorrow. :thumbsup:
